AI.motivation: 现有方法中，强化学习面临稀疏奖励和信用分配困难，而监督微调专家轨迹会过度约束模型到固定轨迹，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: PACT框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 轨迹条件RL代理，在专家轨迹上下文中评估纯提示生成的rollout；(2) 组件感知SFT损失，对推理前缀和工具调用进行退火强度的监督；(3) 纯提示锚定，减少对训练时轨迹上下文的过度依赖。
AI.result: 在FTRL、BFCL和ToolHop三个基准上，PACT consistently优于强SFT和RL基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明特权轨迹协同训练（训练时使用专家轨迹、推理时纯提示）对多轮工具使用学习有重要价值。

title: Architectural Wisdom: A Framework for Governing Optimization in AI Systems
summary: Modern AI systems exhibit structural failures that capability scaling alone does not reliably fix: they optimize under-specified objectives with no architectural mechanism to question whether the objective should be optimized at all. Engagement maximization can amplify harmful pathways; tool-using agents can commit irreversible actions; preference-trained language models can become sycophantic. We argue that this failure is a wisdom problem, not an intelligence problem. We use "wisdom" in a deliberately architectural sense, not as a claim about virtue, consciousness, or moral omniscience. Intelligence accepts a goal and optimizes within it; wisdom interrogates whether the goal should be optimized at all. The two are separable architectural properties. We propose architectural wisdom as a corrigible objective-governance layer above the optimization substrate. The layer makes three structural commitments explicit and nondegenerate before any action: temporal horizon, relational boundary, and irreversibility. It is realized by four components (Structural Utility Transform, Moral Admissibility Interface, Arbitration and Escalation Controller, Value Revision Channel) that compute a six-coordinate wisdom tuple over horizon, relational coverage, irreversibility, admissibility, value revision, and auditability. We motivate the architecture by eight cases drawn from contemporary AI failures, secular wisdom traditions, and hard ethical situations, and defend the distinction against the intelligence-completeness thesis using goal-questioning over goal-taking, Bostrom's orthogonality, structural separation in our exemplar cases, and persistent failure modes despite capability scaling. The framework is the conceptual contract for a larger architecture whose formal specifications and empirical validation are developed in subsequent work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI系统存在“智慧缺失”问题——AI能优化目标，但无法质疑目标本身是否应该被优化。作者提出一种架构性智慧层，包含四个组件和六维智慧元组，用于在行动前显式考虑时间跨度、关系边界和不可逆性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统存在结构性失败：能力扩展无法可靠解决目标优化中的根本缺陷，如放大有害行为、做出不可逆行动、谄媚讨好用户等。作者认为这是智慧问题而非智力问题。
AI.method: 提出架构性智慧层作为可修正的目标治理层，包含四个组件：结构效用变换、道德可接受性接口、仲裁与升级控制器、价值修正通道，计算六维智慧元组（时间跨度、关系覆盖、不可逆性、可接受性、价值修正、可审计性）。
AI.result: 通过八个当代AI失败案例、世俗智慧传统和硬伦理情境进行动机验证，并针对智能完备性论点提出反驳。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是更大架构的概念蓝图，后续工作将进行形式化规范和实证验证。智慧与智能是可分离的架构属性，AI系统需要质疑目标的能力而非仅仅是优化目标的能力。

title: Creative Collision: Directorial Persona Steering and Competition in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Co-Creativity
summary: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful tool for shaping the behaviour of large language models at inference time, yet most prior work injects a \emph{single} semantic direction into the residual stream. We study the richer setting in which two semantically opposing steering vectors are superimposed -- a regime we call \textbf{Creative Collision}. Concretely, we construct directorial persona vectors for Steven Spielberg (optimistic, redemptive moral valence) and Martin Scorsese (dark, morally ambiguous) via mean-difference activation contrast on curated screenplay-derived corpora, then interpolate between them with a scalar mixing parameter $α\in [0,1]$ and a steering coefficient $λ$. Across five evaluation axes -- moral valence, generation coherence, surface style, directional dominance, and vector geometry -- three principal findings emerge: (i)~Spielberg's representational signature exhibits robust \emph{directional dominance}, suppressing Scorsese's moral influence across almost the entire interpolation range; (ii)~intermediate collision points paradoxically \emph{improve} generation coherence relative to pure single-director steering at high $λ$; and (iii)~both personas localise maximally to layer~28 of a 40-layer decoder-only transformer, revealing a shared \emph{moral-tone substrate}. These results illuminate the geometry of competing semantic directions in transformer residual streams and have direct implications for controllable creative generation and value-aligned narrative synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在大型语言模型的残差流中叠加两个语义对立的导演风格向量（斯皮尔伯格 vs 斯科塞斯）的效果，发现斯皮尔伯格的表征方向在大部分插值范围内占据主导，且中间碰撞点反而能提升生成连贯性，两个风格向量在模型第28层共享一个"道德-基调"基底。
AI.motivation: 以往激活引导工作大多向残差流注入单一语义方向，缺乏对两个语义对立向量叠加（即"创造性碰撞"）这一更丰富场景的研究。
AI.method: 通过均值差异激活对比法，基于剧本语料构建斯皮尔伯格（乐观、救赎道德基调）和斯科塞斯（黑暗、道德模糊）的导演人格向量，使用标量混合参数α∈[0,1]和引导系数λ在两者之间插值。
AI.result: (i) 斯皮尔伯格的表征在几乎整个插值范围内压制斯科塞斯的道德影响，表现出鲁棒的方向主导性；(ii) 中间碰撞点在高λ下反而比单一导演引导时生成连贯性更好；(iii) 两人格向量均在40层解码器-only Transformer的第28层定位最大，揭示共享的道德-基调基底。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了Transformer残差流中竞争语义方向的几何特性，对可控创意生成和价值观对齐的叙事合成具有直接启示意义。

title: AdaSTORM: Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable potential in dynamic graph reasoning, but suffer from a scaling bottleneck: current models can only handle graphs with tens of nodes, constrained by exponential reasoning overhead and finite context windows. While multi-agent systems (MAS) offer collective reasoning and topology-aware orchestration, capabilities naturally suited for graph-structured tasks, their application to dynamic graphs remains unexplored. This paper presents Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration (AdaSTORM), a framework that reformulates large-scale dynamic graph reasoning into two stages: (i) Adaptive Partitioning, partitioning large-scale dynamic graphs into subregions that match the model's reasoning capacity while minimizing inference cost; and (ii) Collaborative Reasoning, aligning graph partition topologies with a spatio-temporal decoupled multi-agent architecture. AdaSTORM is the first multi-agent framework tailored for dynamic graph reasoning. Extensive experiments show that AdaSTORM successfully breaks through the scaling bottleneck, scaling reasoning to thousand-node graphs with over 90% accuracy across several large-scale dynamic graph settings without external tools, significantly outperforms seven competitive baselines. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on existing benchmarks and generalizes robustly to real-world datasets. The source code is available at: https://github.com/irisorchid107/AdaSTORM/.

AI.tldr: AdaSTORM是一个将大规模动态图推理扩展到千节点规模、准确率超过90%的多智能体框架，通过自适应分区和时空解耦的多智能体协作突破了大语言模型在图推理中的规模瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在动态图推理中只能处理几十个节点的图，受限于指数级推理开销和有限上下文窗口，而多智能体系统的潜力尚未被挖掘。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：(i) 自适应分区——将大规模动态图划分为匹配模型推理能力的子区域并最小化推理成本；(ii) 协作推理——将图分区拓扑与时空解耦的多智能体架构对齐。
AI.result: 在千节点规模图上实现超过90%准确率，显著优于七个竞争基线，在现有基准上达到SOTA，并鲁棒地泛化到真实数据集。
AI.conclusion: AdaSTORM是首个针对动态图推理的多智能体框架，成功突破了LLM在图推理中的规模瓶颈。

title: Who Should Lead Decoding Now? Tracking Reliable Trajectories for Ensembling Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have emerged as a distinct paradigm for sequence generation. As MDLMs become diverse in capabilities and knowledge coverage, an important question is how to combine their knowledge. Toward this, we first investigate the unique decoding dynamics of MDLMs. We find that successful generations exhibit stable confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions, while unreliable trajectories can often be corrected by injecting promising intermediate states from other models. Guided by this observation, we propose $\textbf{TIE}$ ($\textbf{T}$rajectory-based $\textbf{I}$terative $\textbf{E}$nsembling), a knowledge fusion framework in which MDLMs iteratively identify reliable decoding trajectories and relay them across models. TIE tracks confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions to determine which model currently follows a more reliable trajectory and selectively transfers partially denoised sequences across models. As the model on the more promising trajectory often changes across denoising steps, TIE allows different models to contribute complementary strengths at different stages of generation. Strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, along with our analyses, suggests that TIE offers a practical approach to the underexplored problem of MDLM ensembling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIE框架，通过跟踪和传递MDLM在推理过程中的置信度动态，实现多模型的知识融合与协作生成。
AI.motivation: MDLMs能力日益多样化和专业化，但目前缺乏有效的方法来集成多个MDLM的知识以提升生成质量。
AI.method: 提出TIE（Trajectory-based Iterative Ensembling）框架，通过追踪模型在答案相关位置上的置信度动态，识别更可靠的解码轨迹，并在不同模型之间选择性传递部分去噪的序列，使不同模型在不同生成阶段贡献各自的优势。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务上取得了强劲的性能，验证了TIE框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TIE为MDLM集成这一未被充分探索的问题提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: Exploiting Search in Symbolic Numeric Planning with Patterns
comment: Under Review at the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research
summary: In this paper, we present a procedure for numeric planning based on Symbolic Pattern Planning (SPP). Given a numeric planning problem $Π$, a pattern $\prec$ is a sequence of actions used to define a formula encoding the subsequences of $\prec$ executable from a starting state $S$. Cardellini, Giunchiglia, and Maratea (2024a) follow the Planning as Satisfiability approach by defining, at each step $n \ge 0$, a formula $Π^\prec_n$ in which $(i)$ the pattern $\prec$ is computed only for $n=0$ in the initial state $I$ of $Π$, and then exploited at each step $n$, $(ii)$ the starting state $S$ is set to $I$, and $(iii)$ the set $G$ of goals is required to hold in the last state that can be reached by one of the subsequences of $\prec$ concatenated $n$ times. The procedure begins with $n=0$, terminates as soon as $Π^\prec_n$ is satisfiable, and otherwise proceeds by incrementing $n$. In this paper, possibly at each step, $(i)$ we symbolically search for an intermediate state $P$ reachable from $I$, closer to a goal state, $(ii)$ dynamically recompute the pattern $\prec_h$ -- to be used in the next step -- in $P$, $(iii)$ refine the pattern $\prec_g$ used to reach $P$, and $(iv)$ start the new search from the state $S$ which can be either the initial state $I$ or the last computed intermediate state $P$, exploiting the computed patterns $\prec_g$ and $\prec_h$ to define the pattern $\prec$ to be used in the search. In particular, at each step, we define a formula $Π^{\prec}_{S,P}$ encoding the existence of a state $P'$ closer than $P$ to a goal state, with $P'$ reachable from the starting state $S$ when using the pattern $\prec$. We present different techniques for producing such formulas, each corresponding to a different strategy for exploring the search space. We prove their correctness and completeness, the latter under certain conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于符号模式规划（SPP）的数值规划方法，通过动态重计算模式、搜索中间状态和细化模式来提升规划效率，并证明了其正确性和在特定条件下的完备性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于符号模式规划（SPP）方法在每一步都使用固定的模式，可能无法高效地引导搜索走向目标状态。作者希望动态调整模式，利用中间状态来优化搜索过程，提高求解效率。
AI.method: 在每个步骤中，符号化搜索从初始状态I可达的中间状态P，动态重计算新模式并细化旧模式，从I或P出发利用新模式进行搜索；同时定义了编码状态存在性的公式，并提出了多种搜索空间探索策略。
AI.result: 提出了多种生成公式的技术，每种对应不同的搜索空间探索策略；证明了方法的正确性以及在特定条件下的完备性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过动态调整模式和利用中间状态，提升了数值规划中符号模式规划的灵活性和效率，在理论上保证了正确性和一定条件下的完备性。

title: MamBOA: State-Space Architecture for Video Recognition
summary: Fine-grained action recognition demands temporal reasoning that general-purpose architectures address through different cost-accuracy tradeoffs: 3D dense operators couple computation to the input volume, while difference-based methods approximate motion through rigid, hand-crafted subtraction of uncontextualized features - each reflecting a deliberate design choice with corresponding limitations in expressiveness or flexibility. We present MamBOA, a backbone-agnostic temporal framework built upon a novel interleaved scan structure that recasts the selective state-space recurrence (S6) as a native motion synthesizer. By interleaving consecutive feature representations extracted from a pretrained backbone into a single alternating sequence, the proposed scan structurally drives the recurrence to encode both temporal observations of each position within a shared hidden state, separated by only a single decay step - rendering the inter-frame transition an intrinsic component of the state dynamics rather than an externally computed quantity. A cascade of dedicated alignment and decoding operations then distills this joint encoding into an explicit motion representation, which a dual-path pooling mechanism adaptively aggregates by balancing attention-driven selection with uniform temporal coverage. The framework interfaces seamlessly with CNN, Transformer, and Mamba backbone families, adding only ~2.1 GFLOPs per feature pair. On Diving48, MamBOA achieves 85.02% Top-1 accuracy with an image-pretrained backbone and 86.24% with a video-pretrained backbone processing the entire video in a single forward pass - demonstrating that structurally induced state-space dynamics constitute a principled and general foundation for motion modeling.

AI.tldr: MamBOA是一个与骨干网络无关的时间推理框架，通过交错扫描结构将选择性状态空间循环(S6)重新设计为原生运动合成器，在引入极小计算开销(~2.1 GFLOPs)的情况下，在Diving48数据集上达到85-86%的Top-1准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度动作识别方法存在成本-精度权衡的固有局限：3D密集算子计算量与输入体积绑定，而基于差分的方法依赖刚性、手工设计的无上下文特征减法，缺乏表达力和灵活性。
AI.method: 提出MamBOA框架，核心是交错扫描结构：将预训练骨干网络提取的连续特征表示交织成单个交替序列，驱动状态空间循环在同一隐藏状态内编码相邻帧的时间观察，使帧间过渡成为状态动力学的内在组成部分；再通过对齐与解码操作蒸馏出显式运动表示，并由双路径池化机制自适应聚合。
AI.result: 在Diving48数据集上，使用图像预训练骨干网络达到85.02% Top-1准确率，使用视频预训练骨干网络达到86.24% Top-1准确率，仅增加约2.1 GFLOPs计算量，且与CNN、Transformer、Mamba等骨干网络兼容。
AI.conclusion: 结构诱导的状态空间动力学为运动建模提供了一个有原则且通用的基础，MamBOA证明了将状态空间循环重新设计为运动合成器的有效性和泛化性。

title: HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents rely on memory mechanisms to compress interaction history, but optimizing memory writing faces a distinct credit assignment challenge: a memory update may be rewarded or penalized due to downstream tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution. This causally entangled credit can lead agents to discard useful evidence or preserve irrelevant information. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework for assigning less-entangled credit to memory-writing actions in long-horizon agents. HiMPO first estimates the local utility of a memory update by comparing the task-relevant information recoverable from the previous and updated memories under the same pre-write state. It then uses hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter that attenuates memory credit when local utility is not supported by the target outcome. The resulting memory-specific advantage is applied only to memory tokens, while trajectory-level rewards optimize the rest of the agent behavior. Across judge-based open-domain tasks and objective compressive-memory QA, HiMPO improves over strong memory-based and RL-based baselines while preserving compressed-context efficiency. Controlled interventions further show that HiMPO reduces blame leakage from tool-induced errors and improves attribution fidelity of memory updates.

AI.tldr: HiMPO提出了一种事后知情记忆策略优化框架，通过区分局部效用与全局结果来减少长时程智能体记忆更新的因果混淆，从而改善记忆写入的信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体依赖记忆机制压缩交互历史，但记忆写入面临信用分配难题：记忆更新的奖励或惩罚可能来自下游工具故障、观测噪声或推理错误，而非记忆本身。这种因果纠缠会导致智能体丢弃有用证据或保留无关信息。
AI.method: HiMPO首先通过比较同一预写状态下前后记忆能恢复的任务相关信息，估计记忆更新的局部效用；然后使用事后相关性作为有界回顾滤波器，当局部效用不被目标结果支持时衰减记忆信用；最终将记忆特定优势值仅应用于记忆令牌，而轨迹级奖励优化其余行为。
AI.result: 在基于评判的开放域任务和客观压缩记忆问答任务上，HiMPO优于强记忆基线和基于RL的基线，同时保持压缩上下文效率。控制实验表明HiMPO减少了工具诱导错误的归因泄漏，提高了记忆更新的归因忠实度。
AI.conclusion: HiMPO通过解耦记忆更新的局部效用与全局结果，有效缓解了长时程智能体中记忆写入的信用分配问题，在多个任务上取得了更优性能与更高的归因准确性。

title: Phase-Aware Guidance Injection for Recurrent MAPPO in Assembly-Line Disruption Recovery
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE 2026)
summary: Disruption recovery in industrial assembly lines requires timely decisions under machine faults, worker absence, and emergency orders. Existing methods either rely on rigid handcrafted recovery logic or learn adaptive policies that do not readily exploit heterogeneous external recovery knowledge at decision time to reduce abnormal recovery time (ART) and preserve on-time delivery (OTD). To address this gap, we propose a phase-aware guidance injection framework that augments a trained recurrent MAPPO (RMAPPO) scheduling policy through logit-level action bias during evaluation. The framework provides a unified decision-time interface for rule-based, replay-based, and online LLM-based guidance, while activating intervention only during abnormal and recovery phases. Experiments on a custom AssemblyLineEnv show that high-quality rule guidance yields the strongest gains, replay-based guidance degrades smoothly under imperfect availability, and online LLM guidance still provides useful intermediate improvements. These results show that decision-time guidance injection can exploit heterogeneous recovery hints without redesigning the actor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种相位感知引导注入框架，在评估时通过logit层动作偏置增强RMAPPO调度策略，支持基于规则、回放和在线LLM的异构恢复知识注入，有效减少异常恢复时间并保障准时交付。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖刚性手工恢复逻辑，要么学习自适应策略但无法在决策时利用异构外部恢复知识来减少异常恢复时间（ART）并保障准时交付（OTD）。
AI.method: 提出相位感知引导注入框架，在评估阶段通过logit级动作偏置增强训练好的RMAPPO调度策略，提供统一的决策时接口支持基于规则、回放和在线LLM的引导，仅在异常和恢复阶段激活干预。
AI.result: 在自定义AssemblyLineEnv上实验表明：高质量规则引导增益最大，回放引导在可用性不完美时性能平滑下降，在线LLM引导能提供有用的中间改进。
AI.conclusion: 决策时引导注入可在不重设计Actor的情况下利用异构恢复提示，有效提升装配线异常恢复性能。

title: Enhancing Precision Agriculture with a Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Plant Disease Classification and Interpretability
summary: This study proposes an overall deep learning architecture for multi-class classification of plant diseases from high-resolution leaf imagery, with a particular interest in investigating the behavior of ResNet-50 and a hybrid ResNet + Vision Transformer (ViT) design. A specially gathered image database with 15,200 training images and 3,800 validation images spanning 38 classes across multiple crops, including tomato, apple, grape etc. were subjected to preprocessing steps such as resizing, normalization, and data augmentation to enhance model robustness. Multiple architectures, including ResNet-50, MobileNetV2, and EfficientNet-B0, were trained and compared with the hybrid ResNet + ViT model. All models were fine-tuned using the AdamW optimizer and cross-entropy loss, with early stopping applied to prevent overfitting and ensure generalization. Furthermore, interpretability techniques such as Grad-CAM and saliency maps were implemented to indicate disease-relevant regions, while segmentation-based analysis was performed to identify the affected parts of a leaf. For every one of the considered architectures, ResNet-50 led to the highest accuracy of 98.74%, whereas the hybrid ResNet + ViT model achieved a competitive accuracy of 98.58%, showing that the hybrid architectures were effective in capturing both local and overall information. The experimental results showcase the promise of transformer-based models to achieve highly accurate, interpretable, and computationally efficient computer-based multi-class multi-disease classification systems, providing helpful assistance for cultivation management practices as well as for precision farming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于植物病害多分类的深度学习架构，比较了ResNet-50与混合ResNet+ViT模型，其中ResNet-50以98.74%的准确率领先，混合模型以98.58%紧随其后，并通过Grad-CAM等可解释性技术验证了模型聚焦病害区域的能力。
AI.motivation: 传统植物病害分类方法精度有限，且难以同时捕捉局部细节与全局特征。本文旨在探索ResNet与Vision Transformer混合架构在植物病害多分类中的潜力，以构建更准确、可解释且计算高效的智能诊断系统，辅助精准农业和栽培管理。
AI.method: 构建包含15,200张训练图像和3,800张验证图像、涵盖38类（番茄、苹果、葡萄等）的数据集，经预处理（调整大小、归一化、数据增强）后，训练ResNet-50、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B0及混合ResNet+ViT模型，使用AdamW优化器、交叉熵损失和早停策略。并采用Grad-CAM、显著性图进行可解释性分析，以及分割分析识别叶片病害区域。
AI.result: ResNet-50达到最高准确率98.74%，混合ResNet+ViT模型以98.58%的准确率紧随其后，均优于MobileNetV2和EfficientNet-B0。可解释性分析显示模型能准确聚焦病害区域。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的混合架构在植物病害多分类中表现出色，能够有效融合局部与全局信息，兼具高精度、可解释性和计算效率，为精准农业中的自动化病害识别提供了可行方案。

title: PaperJury: Due-Process Review for Bounded LaTeX Revision
summary: Pre-submission hardening of human-authored LaTeX computer science papers differs from drafting assistance because it requires adversarial whole-paper review, explicit no-fix outcomes, and bounded artifact-safe revision. Existing writing assistants, critique generators, and judge-centered loops lack durable issue identity across rounds, deterministic routing from critique to adjudication, and manuscript control that can reject invalid concerns or defer author-dependent ones. We present PaperJury, a closed-loop review-verdict-revise-verify system built on a deterministic-versus-semantic split: deterministic orchestration manages decomposition, a frozen claim spine, a durable ledger, routing, stopping, and exact-once patch application, while semantic agents are limited to bounded review, judgment, and repair. PaperJury combines bounded holistic review, contestability-based routing, a due-process trial, and risk-proportional guard chains for anchor-bounded edits, yielding terminal outcomes of invalid-drop, valid-fixable, and author-required. In a two-arm expert-review evaluation on held-out Vision, natural language processing, and machine learning papers against four baselines, we assess issue quality, verdict and routing quality, edit safety, convergence behavior, and cost, supporting the thesis that load-bearing safety and completion logic should reside in deterministic orchestration rather than model discretion. PaperJury is available at https://github.com/u7079256/paperjury.

AI.tldr: PaperJury：一个封闭循环的论文预提交审查系统，采用确定性编排与语义智能体分离的架构，实现可回溯、可路由、可控的同行评议流程。
AI.motivation: 现有的写作助手、评审生成器和以裁判为中心的循环缺乏跨轮次的持久问题标识、从评审到裁决的确定性路由，以及能够拒绝无效关切或推迟依赖作者决策的手稿控制能力。
AI.method: 提出PaperJury系统，采用确定性编排与语义智能体分离的设计：确定性部分负责分解、冻结声明骨架、持久账本、路由、停止和精确一次补丁应用；语义智能体限于有界评审、判断和修复。包含有界整体评审、基于可争议性的路由、正当程序审判和风险比例保护链。
AI.result: 在两轮专家评估中，针对视觉、NLP和ML论文，与四个基线相比，评估了问题质量、裁决与路由质量、编辑安全性、收敛行为和成本。
AI.conclusion: 证明承载安全性和完成逻辑应存在于确定性编排而非模型自由裁量中。

title: Decoupled Motion Representation Learning for Moving Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection in dynamic scenes remains challenging due to the highly coupled motions among targets, imaging platforms, and dynamic backgrounds. Existing multi-frame methods usually perform implicit temporal modeling, where coherent background dynamics dominate motion correspondence learning, leading to an inherent trade-off between detection and false alarms. In this work, we observe that background motions exhibit strong global coherence, whereas small targets mainly correspond to sparse local motion anomalies. Moreover, many false-alarm responses maintain high consistency with globally coherent motion patterns, indicating that they mainly originate from coherent background dynamics rather than genuine target motions. Based on these observations, we propose a decoupled motion representation learning framework for moving infrared small target detection. Specifically, an explicit motion branch is introduced to model globally coherent motion dynamics using pretrained optical flow priors, together with a structure-preserving self-supervised adaptation strategy for infrared motion correspondence learning. Meanwhile, an implicit motion branch based on deformable feature alignment is designed to capture target-sensitive local motion anomalies under coherent motion guidance. Furthermore, a coherent-motion-guided local anomaly reasoning module is proposed to identify and suppress coherent-motion-induced false responses during localized motion modeling. Extensive experiments on two challenging infrared small target detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in dynamic scenes with complex motions, while maintaining favorable inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 针对红外小目标检测中背景与目标运动高度耦合的问题，提出解耦运动表征学习框架，通过显式运动分支建模全局一致背景运动、隐式运动分支捕捉稀疏局部运动异常，并设计一致运动引导的局部异常推理模块抑制虚警，在动态场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多帧的方法通常进行隐式时间建模，背景的连贯动态主导了运动对应学习，导致检测与虚警之间存在固有权衡；而观察到背景运动具有强全局一致性，小目标对应稀疏局部运动异常，且大量虚警源于连贯背景动态而非真实目标运动。
AI.method: 提出解耦运动表征学习框架：(1) 显式运动分支，利用预训练光流先验建模全局连贯运动，并引入结构保持的自监督自适应策略；(2) 隐式运动分支，基于可变形特征对齐捕获目标敏感的局部运动异常；(3) 一致运动引导的局部异常推理模块，识别并抑制连贯运动引发的虚警响应。
AI.result: 在两个挑战性红外小目标检测基准上，该方法在动态场景中一致超越现有最先进方法，同时保持良好的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局连贯背景运动与稀疏局部目标运动显式解耦，并针对性抑制背景驱动的虚警，有效解决了动态场景下红外小目标检测中检测与虚警的权衡问题。

title: Whose hotel does the AI recommend? An algorithm audit of reputation signals in LLM-assisted hotel selection
summary: Travelers increasingly ask large language model (LLM) assistants which hotel to book, making these systems gatekeepers of property visibility -- yet what moves their recommendations is undocumented. We conduct a pre-specified algorithm audit using a randomized choice-based conjoint: across personas, prompt templates, and twelve open-weight and proprietary models, assistants choose among five hotels whose guest rating, review volume and recency, management response, chain affiliation, price, eco-certification, and list position are independently randomized. We estimate the average marginal component effect of each signal on the probability of recommendation. Guest rating and price dominate (a top rating raises selection by 31.6 percentage points; a high price lowers it by 30.0), reproducing human valence-and-price primacy but over-weighting eco-certification and ignoring management response. List position -- a content-free artifact -- shifts recommendations causally, worth about \$12 per night. Stated reasons track revealed weights imperfectly. The findings ground generative engine optimization and the accountability of AI infomediaries in causal evidence.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机化选择联合分析审计了12种大语言模型在推荐酒店时的决策机制，发现用户评分和价格是主导因素，而列表位置等无意义特征也会显著影响推荐结果。
AI.motivation: 旅行者越来越依赖LLM助手推荐酒店，但这些系统的推荐依据尚不明确，缺乏系统的因果证据来理解其决策机制。
AI.method: 采用预注册的算法审计方法，通过随机化选择联合分析，在多种角色设定、提示模板和12种开源/专有模型中，独立随机化酒店的评分、评论量、评论时效性、管理回复、连锁品牌、价格、生态认证和列表位置等8个信号，估计各信号的平均边际成分效应。
AI.result: 用户评分和价格是推荐的主导因素（顶级评分提升推荐概率31.6个百分点，高价格降低30.0个百分点）；LLM过度重视生态认证而忽略管理回复；列表位置这一无内容意义的特征产生因果影响，价值约每晚12美元；模型陈述的理由与实际权重不完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究为生成式引擎优化和AI信息中介的问责提供了因果证据基础，揭示了LLM推荐系统的偏差和可操纵性。

title: G2IA: Geometry-Guided Instance-Aware Retrieval and Refinement for Cross-Modal Place Recognition
summary: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) enables camera-only robots to localize against pre-built LiDAR maps in autonomous navigation scenarios. This image-to-point-cloud setting is challenged by two coupled ambiguities: the modality gap between perspective RGB appearance and sparse metric geometry, and perceptual aliasing among urban places with similar roads, facades, intersections, and object arrangements. Instead of treating CMPR as a single global descriptor matching problem, we argue that reliable retrieval requires both geometry-aware representation alignment and fine-grained candidate verification. In this paper, we propose G2IA, a geometry-guided instance-aware framework for image-to-point-cloud place recognition. In the retrieval stage, visual geometry priors from VGGT and instance features are integrated to construct place descriptors that are more compatible with LiDAR-derived map representations. In the refinement stage, the retrieved candidates are re-ranked by explicitly verifying whether local instance shapes and their relative spatial layouts are consistent across modalities. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that G2IA consistently improves image-to-point-cloud place recognition under different localization thresholds, and exhibits strong cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: G2IA是一个面向图像到点云跨模态地点识别的几何引导实例感知框架，通过检索阶段的视觉几何先验与实例特征融合，以及精炼阶段的跨模态实例形状与空间布局一致性验证，显著提升了定位性能。
AI.motivation: 跨模态地点识别面临模态差异（RGB图像与稀疏点云）和城市环境感知混淆（相似道路、建筑、路口）的双重挑战，现有全局描述子方法难以有效解决这两个耦合的歧义问题。
AI.method: 提出G2IA框架，包含两个阶段：1) 检索阶段：利用VGGT提取视觉几何先验，结合实例特征构建与LiDAR地图更兼容的地点描述子；2) 精炼阶段：显式验证检索候选结果中局部实例形状及其相对空间布局在跨模态下的一致性，对候选进行重排序。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，G2IA在不同定位阈值下均一致提升了图像到点云地点识别的性能，并展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将CMPR从单一的全局描述子匹配问题扩展为几何感知表示对齐与细粒度候选验证相结合的方法，能够有效解决模态差异与感知混淆的双重挑战。

title: Tyler: Typed Latent Reasoning for Language Models -- When to Think, What to Compute, and How Much to Allocate
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs) by externalizing intermediate computation as discrete text tokens, but this textual interface also introduces redundancy and inference overhead. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by carrying part of the computation in continuous representations. However, existing methods typically predefine when latent computation is invoked and how it is allocated during decoding, leaving a key problem unresolved: when to invoke latent computation, what type of computation to perform, and how much budget to allocate. We propose \textbf{Ty}ped \textbf{L}at\textbf{e}nt \textbf{R}easoning (Tyler), a typed and budget-aware framework for latent reasoning during autoregressive decoding. Tyler learns a policy that, at each decoding step, chooses between emitting a text token and switching to a latent computation module specialized for a particular reasoning function. Once invoked, an operator maps the current reasoning state into latent tokens that support global planning, local state updates, or reusable procedural abstraction. Across extensive experiments on three backbone LLMs, Tyler improves accuracy by up to 14.49 points over CoT and by up to 4.30 points over the strongest competing baseline. It further generalizes across diverse reasoning domains and achieves the best final-stage performance with the lowest forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出Typer框架，通过学习策略在自回归解码中动态选择文本生成或三种类型的潜在推理（全局规划、局部状态更新、程序抽象），提升推理准确率并降低遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有链式思维推理存在冗余和推理开销，潜在推理虽能缓解但缺乏对何时调用、调用何种计算以及分配多少预算的有效控制。
AI.method: 提出Typer框架，训练一个策略网络在每步解码时选择输出文本token或调用三种专用潜在计算模块（全局规划、局部状态更新、可复用程序抽象），并动态分配计算预算。
AI.result: 在三个骨干LLM上，准确率相比CoT提升最高14.49点，相比最强基线提升最高4.30点；跨推理领域泛化能力强，且遗忘率最低。
AI.conclusion: Typer通过类型化与预算感知的潜在推理框架，在提升推理性能的同时有效降低了知识遗忘，优于现有方法。

title: Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly refutes the intuitive "crowded-harness / lost-in-the-middle" explanation: the failure is at the decision readout, not the harness, and we pin it there three ways. (1) Input vs. readout: repairing the prompt (reordering or duplicating the gold tool) recovers <=23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59-91%. (2) Representation-invariance: two gold-pointed interventions in different representations -- an additive attention-logit bias and a residual-stream steering vector -- recover largely the same failures (per-task Jaccard 0.865 pooled, 0.79-0.91 per model), so the bottleneck is localized to the readout independent of which representation is poked. (3) A training-free, gold-free selector: per-segment attention closes most of the gold-free-vs-oracle gap on BFCL (+11.9 pts pooled function-name selection vs. +17.9-pt oracle headroom) and adds +14.9 pts on Seal-Tools; every model positive (exact McNemar p<=8e-4 each). Scopes differ: the causal attention-bias dose-response is bidirectional and monotonic on 10 mask-honoring models (3-32B), the full 0.5-32B span carrying only the correlational diagnostic; the deployable selector is evaluated on 5 single-turn models and does not yet transfer to a multi-turn loop.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体工具调用失败并非因为“在拥挤工具列表中找不到正确工具”，而是注意力机制已经定位到正确工具却在决策读出阶段出错。通过注意力偏置和残差流干预可恢复59-91%的失败案例，并提出基于注意力片段的免训练选择器。
AI.motivation: 挑战直观的“拥挤工具/中间丢失”解释，证明LLM智能体工具调用失败的根本原因不在输入编码阶段，而在决策读出阶段。
AI.method: (1) 对比输入修复（重排序/重复目标工具）与读出端干预效果；(2) 两种不同表征（注意力logit偏置、残差流干预）下验证故障定位一致性；(3) 提出基于注意力片段的免训练免金标选择器。
AI.result: 模型80%情况下注意力集中在正确工具（随机基线21%），仅有10%失败是因注意力未覆盖；输入修复仅恢复≤23%失败，读出干预恢复59-91%；两种干预恢复的失败案例Jaccard相似度达0.865；选择器在BFCL提升+11.9pts，Seal-Tools提升+14.9pts。
AI.conclusion: 工具调用失败的瓶颈在决策读出阶段而非注意力定位阶段，基于注意力片段的干预和选择器有效。

title: Evaluating LLM Personalization via Semantic Constraint Verification
summary: Current evaluation paradigms for Large Language Model (LLM) personalization rely heavily on brittle surface-matching metrics or computationally expensive LLM-as-a-judge protocols, both of which lack interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce Natural Language Inference Constraint Verification (NLICV), a scalable, semantically invariant framework that maps sentence meanings to truth-condition sets to verify personalization constraints via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model. Moving beyond binary scoring, NLICV categorizes LLM behaviors into four distinct modes: personalization, generalization, sycophancy, and failure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NLICV aligns closely with human annotations while drastically reducing the latency and token costs associated with LLM judges (up to 2100 inference speedup). Finally, through an ablation-based procedure, NLICV pinpoints the exact sentences driving the constraint verification, yielding faithful, understandable evidence for its evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出NLICV框架，利用NLI模型将句子映射为真值条件集，实现可解释、高效且语义不变的LLM个性化约束验证，相比LLM评判方法提速2100倍，并支持关键证据定位。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化评估方法依赖脆弱的表面匹配指标或计算昂贵的LLM-as-a-judge方案，缺乏可解释性，亟需一种可扩展、语义不变且可解释的评估框架。
AI.method: 将句子含义映射为真值条件集，通过NLI模型验证个性化约束；将LLM行为分为个性化、泛化、谄媚和失败四种模式；采用消融程序定位关键句子作为证据。
AI.result: 与人类标注高度一致，相比LLM评判方法推理速度提升高达2100倍，显著降低延迟和token成本。
AI.conclusion: NLICV是一种高效、可解释且语义不变的LLM个性化评估框架，能提供忠实易懂的评估证据，优于现有方法。

title: Posterior Twins: Distributional Behavioral Simulation for Enterprise Decisions
summary: Enterprise behavioral simulation requires more than producing a plausible response. Many decisions depend on the shape of a population under a proposed action: which segments accept, defect, hesitate, or move into risk-sensitive states. This paper introduces Posterior Twins, a memory-grounded digital-twin approach that represents likely behavior as an updated distribution under a specific decision context. We evaluate a family of Twinning Labs behavioral-model operating points on a 226-example held-out behavioral-response benchmark and report both modal accuracy and Wasserstein-1 distance. The results show that modal accuracy and distributional fidelity identify different operating regimes. TL-Twin Alpha achieves the lowest observed Wasserstein-1 distance in the reported result set ($W_1 = 1.16$), while TL-Twin Delta and TL-Twin Gamma provide balanced operating points near the modal-accuracy frontier. The paper frames these results as a systems result: governed memory, behavioral model routing, scenario orchestration, distributional aggregation, and auditability are necessary for turning simulated behavior into reusable enterprise decision evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Posterior Twins，一种基于记忆的数字孪生方法，将群体行为表示为在特定决策语境下的更新分布，并在行为响应基准上评估了不同模型变体的模态准确率和Wasserstein-1距离。
AI.motivation: 企业行为模拟仅产生合理的单一响应是不够的，许多决策依赖于群体在某一行动下的分布形态（如哪些细分群体接受、拒绝、犹豫或进入风险敏感状态），因此需要能够捕捉群体分布变化的方法。
AI.method: 提出Posterior Twins方法，这是一种基于记忆的数字孪生方法，在特定决策语境下将群体行为表示为更新后的概率分布；并在包含226个样本的行为响应基准上评估了多个Twinning Labs模型变体。
AI.result: 模态准确率与分布保真度识别出不同的运行区间。TL-Twin Alpha在报告结果中达到最低的Wasserstein-1距离（W_1=1.16），而TL-Twin Delta和TL-Twin Gamma提供了接近模态准确率前沿的均衡运行点。
AI.conclusion: 本文从系统角度指出，受控记忆、行为模型路由、场景编排、分布聚合和可审计性是将模拟行为转化为可复用的企业决策证据所必需的要素。

title: Surpassing Scale by Efficiency: A Compact 135M Parameter Foundational LLM Natively Adapted for the Bangla Language
summary: While the NLP landscape is dominated by multi-billion parameter architectures, their deployment in low-resource, non-Latin scripts remains computationally prohibitive for edge configurations, mobile systems, and decentralized local hardware. This paper presents bangla-smollm-135m, a highly compact 135-million parameter decoder-only foundational model engineered explicitly for high-efficiency language modeling in the Bangla script. By leveraging a deterministic intersect-and-append token merging strategy between TituLLMs and SmolLM2-135M, the model overcomes subword script fragmentation without destabilizing early pretrained parameter states. In zero-shot multi-task benchmark evaluations (PIQA_bn, OpenBookQA_bn, CommonsenseQA_bn, and Bangla_MMLU), bangla-smollm-135m matches or outperforms models twice its size (Gemma-3-270m) and achieves parity with models in the 1B parameter tier. The model is available at rnnandi/bangla-smollm-135m

AI.tldr: 提出了一种仅135M参数的孟加拉语小型语言模型bangla-smollm-135m，通过创新的令牌合并策略，在零样本多任务评估中匹配或超越了两倍甚至10倍于其规模的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模NLP模型在非拉丁语系、低资源场景下的边缘设备、移动系统和去中心化硬件上部署存在计算瓶颈，亟需一种高效紧凑的孟加拉语基础模型。
AI.method: 采用确定性的"交集-追加"（intersect-and-append）令牌合并策略，融合TituLLMs和SmolLM2-135M两种模型，在不破坏预训练参数稳定性的前提下解决子词脚本碎片化问题。
AI.result: 在PIQA_bn、OpenBookQA_bn、CommonsenseQA_bn和Bangla_MMLU等零样本多任务基准上，135M的模型匹配或超越Gemma-3-270m（2倍大小）以及1B参数级别的模型。
AI.conclusion: 验证了通过巧妙的令牌合并策略，小参数模型在特定低资源语言上能够实现与大模型相当的性能，为边缘部署提供了可行方案。

title: When Agent Automation Becomes Profitable: Quantifying and Insuring Autonomous AI Risk through Trace-Economic Underwriting
summary: AI agents can now take irreversible actions in operational systems, but agent-caused losses are still not clearly assigned, priced, or transferred. Providers often disclaim consequential damages, users are left with uncompensated losses, and default human review limits the efficiency gains of automation. We ask when autonomous AI deployment can become economically acceptable despite failure risk. Our answer is to quantify risk at the customer-task-trace episode level and transfer it through insurance. Automation is acceptable when its expected benefit exceeds the premium, control cost, and remaining risk. This requires a defined role with bounded permissions and comparable traces. We introduce trace-economic underwriting, which maps tool-use traces to customer exposure and claimable loss, then uses this representation for pricing, control, and risk transfer. It uses deterministic economic labels rather than an LLM judge. In our trace-to-loss testbed, trace-economic pricing reduces pricing MAE from $17.7K to $569 and removes regressive cross-subsidy. A 300-trace expert audit accepts 295 labels unchanged. On 1,000 real SWE-smith traces, trace-conditioned controls reduce CVaR95 by 72%. Theorem~1 gives a finite-sample scope condition. We release code, labels, and audit sheets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过“痕迹经济核保”方法，将AI代理的风险量化并转移至保险体系，从而实现自动化在经济上可接受。
AI.motivation: AI代理可能造成不可逆损失，但责任归属不清、缺乏风险定价与转移机制，用户损失无法补偿，且人工审查限制了自动化效率。
AI.method: 提出痕迹经济核保方法：将工具使用痕迹映射为客户暴露与可索赔损失，用于定价、控制和风险转移；采用确定性经济标签而非LLM判断。
AI.result: 痕迹经济定价将MAE从17.7K降至569美元，消除逆向补贴；300条痕迹专家审核接受295条标签；1000条真实痕迹下CVaR95降低72%。
AI.conclusion: 通过痕迹级别的风险量化与保险转移，可在预期收益覆盖保费、控制成本和剩余风险时，实现自动化的经济可接受性。

title: Conditional Multi-Event Temporal Grounding in Long-Form Video
summary: Multimodal large language models have made rapid progress in video temporal grounding, yet real-world applications routinely require localizing every event that satisfies compositional temporal and spatial conditions. Existing benchmarks fall short: they localize only a single moment per query, count without temporal conditions, or treat grounding and counting as disjoint tasks. We introduce CoMET-Bench for Conditional Multi-Event Temporal Grounding in long-form video, comprising 2789 queries over 600 videos averaging 33.8 minutes across five real-world domains, with each query composed from 4 temporal conditions, 3 spatial conditions, and a dedicated negative-query subset. We further propose a unified evaluation protocol jointly measuring counting, grounding, and negative-query recognition, including a new Rejection-F1 metric that prevents trivial gaming by lazy "always-empty" models. Benchmarking a broad suite of MLLMs, agent-based, and grounding-specialized methods reveals that existing approaches remain far from solving this task. Building on these findings, we propose CoMET-Agent, a training-free agentic framework that reformulates the task as structured search-and-aggregate, improving F1@0.5 by 6.1% over GPT-5 purely through structural reasoning. Failure analysis further surfaces three open directions: fine-grained entity tracking, position-uniform retrieval, and causal event pairing.

AI.tldr: 提出了CoMET-Bench基准和CoMET-Agent框架，用于评估和解决长视频中满足时空条件的事件计数与定位任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基准要么只定位单时刻、要么计数无时间条件，无法处理实际应用中需要同时满足组合时空条件的多事件定位需求。
AI.method: 构建了含2789个查询、600个长视频的CoMET-Bench基准，每个查询包含4个时间条件+3个空间条件及负样本子集；提出统一评估协议（含Rejection-F1指标）；设计CoMET-Agent训练无关智能体框架，将任务重构为结构化搜索-聚合。
AI.result: CoMET-Agent在F1@0.5上比GPT-5提升6.1%；现有方法均远未解决该任务。
AI.conclusion: 该任务具有挑战性，未来需关注细粒度实体追踪、位置均匀检索和因果事件配对三个方向。

title: A Mechanistic Understanding of Pronoun Fidelity in LLMs
summary: Faithful and robust pronoun use is important for fair and coherent generations, yet large language models largely fail when multiple referents use different pronouns. To study the interplay of reasoning, repetition, and bias in this task, prior work relies exclusively on behavioural approaches, which may not reflect a model's internal workings. Therefore, we provide a mechanistic, model-internal perspective on pronoun fidelity, testing whether three mechanisms -- group entity binding (G), recency bias (R), and stereotypical bias (S) -- are causally implemented across several SOTA language models. Using Boundless Distributed Alignment Search, we find all three coexist as causal subspaces distributed across network depth. No single mechanism fully explains model behaviour, but a combination of the three consistently accounts for 91-99.5%. An attention head analysis further reveals two competing copying routes; group binding and stereotype share a localized concept-level route that retrieves a bound occupation-pronoun unit, while recency uses a distributed token-level route that repeats surface forms. In sum, pronoun fidelity arises from competition between simultaneously active causal subspaces.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机械可解释性方法，发现大语言模型在代词忠实度上存在三种因果机制（群体绑定、近因偏差、刻板偏见），三者共同作用解释91-99.5%的行为，并通过注意力头分析揭示了两种竞争性的复制路径。
AI.motivation: 先前研究仅从行为层面考察代词使用中的推理、重复和偏见问题，无法反映模型内部工作机制，因此需要从机制层面探究代词忠实度的内部因果机制。
AI.method: 使用Boundless Distributed Alignment Search方法，在多个SOTA语言模型上测试群体绑定（G）、近因偏差（R）和刻板偏见（S）三种机制是否被因果实现。
AI.result: 三种机制以因果子空间形式共存于网络深度中，组合解释力达91-99.5%；发现两种竞争性复制路径：群体绑定和刻板偏见共享概念级路径（束缚的代词-职业单元），近因偏差使用分布式token级路径（重复表面形式）。
AI.conclusion: 代词忠实度源于同时激活的因果子空间之间的竞争。

title: Tensor-Coord: Algebraic Decomposition of Joint Plan Tensors for Conflict-Free Multi-Agent LLM Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain limited in multi-agent planning because independently generated plans can create coordination failures such as spatial collisions, resource contention, and temporal deadlocks. We introduce Tensor-Coord, a multilinear algebra framework that represents the joint plan of N agents as a third-order tensor \(T \in R^{N \times H \times A}\) over agents, timesteps, and actions. Canonical Polyadic (CP) and Tucker decompositions are used to identify latent coordination structure. The minimal epsilon-approximate CP rank R* defines a computable coordination complexity measure, with \(CC(Pi)=(R*-N)/N\). We prove that R*=N is necessary and sufficient for plan independence. The residual \(E=T-T_{R*}\) defines a conflict score over agent pairs, timesteps, and actions, localizing failures without domain-specific rules. Tucker factors provide interpretable agent roles, temporal phases, and action clusters that are converted into natural language constraints for iterative LLM replanning. Experiments on multi-robot delivery tasks across Easy (2 agents, 5x5 grid), Medium (3 agents, 5x5 grid), and Hard (4 agents, 5x5 grid) settings show convergence to conflict-free plans in 100% of 2-agent cases within 1.4 iterations on average, 80% of 3-agent cases within 3.2 iterations, and 60% of 4-agent cases within 4.0 iterations. CP rank scaled approximately linearly as \(R*(N) = 3.9N + 0.5\), supporting its use as a predictor of coordination complexity.

AI.tldr: Tensor-Coord 是一种基于多线性代数的框架，通过张量分解（CP和Tucker）表示多智能体联合计划，可量化协调复杂度并定位冲突，实验证明能有效实现多智能体冲突消解。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多智能体规划中因独立生成计划导致协调失败（如空间碰撞、资源竞争、时间死锁），现有方法缺乏可量化的协调复杂度度量与通用的冲突定位机制。
AI.method: 将N个智能体的联合计划表示为三阶张量 \(T \in R^{N \times H \times A}\)，利用CP分解计算最小ε-近似秩R*定义协调复杂度CC，Tucker分解提取潜在角色、时间阶段和动作聚类并转化为自然语言约束，迭代引导LLM重新规划。
AI.result: 在2智能体场景100%收敛到无冲突计划（平均1.4轮），3智能体80%（3.2轮），4智能体60%（4.0轮）。CP秩近似线性增长 \(R*(N) = 3.9N + 0.5\)，验证了其作为协调复杂度预测指标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 证明了CP秩R*=N是计划独立性的充要条件，张量分解方法可有效量化协调复杂度、定位冲突并提供可解释的协调约束，为大语言模型多智能体规划提供了系统化框架。

title: PathRouter: Aligning Rewards with Retrieval Quality in Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Agentic GraphRAG trains language-model agents to iteratively retrieve and reason over graph-structured evidence, enabling more accurate and context-aware decision-making by efficiently navigating complex information networks. However, outcome-only reinforcement learning suffers from \textit{\textbf{answer-path reward aliasing}}, where correct answers may come from shortcuts rather than useful evidence paths. It also exhibits \textit{\textbf{search-update ambiguity}}, as scalar trajectory-level feedback does not indicate which retrieval actions to adjust. To mitigate these shortcomings, we present PathRouter, a path-aware training framework for agentic GraphRAG. PathRouter jointly evaluates each trajectory along answer correctness and evidence-path overlap, yielding four trajectory categories with differentiated GRPO advantage scaling that suppresses shortcut reinforcement while preserving evidence-seeking behavior. For evidence-poor trajectories, a frozen gold-evidence teacher provides token-level KL guidance on reasoning and search-query tokens, excluding answer tokens to avoid direct response imitation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks across three model sizes show that PathRouter consistently improves answer F1 and evidence-path overlap, achieving average F1 gains of 3.1 on 3B and 4.9 on 7B models compared to a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: PathRouter是一个针对Agentic GraphRAG的路径感知训练框架，通过联合评估答案正确性和证据路径重叠度来缓解奖励混叠和搜索更新模糊问题，在六个QA基准测试中显著提升了F1分数和证据路径重叠度。
AI.motivation: 现有Agentic GraphRAG使用仅基于结果的强化学习存在两个问题：(1) 答案路径奖励混叠——正确答案可能来自捷径而非有用的证据路径；(2) 搜索更新模糊性——标量轨迹级反馈无法指示应调整哪些检索动作。这些问题阻碍了模型学习真正有效的证据搜索策略。
AI.method: PathRouter提出三个关键组件：(1) 四类轨迹划分——联合评估答案正确性和证据路径重叠度，将轨迹分为四类；(2) 差异化GRPO优势缩放——抑制捷径强化，保留证据搜索行为；(3) 冻结的金标准证据教师——对低证据轨迹提供token级KL引导（仅约束推理和搜索查询token，排除答案token以避免直接模仿）。
AI.result: 在六个QA基准测试上，使用三种模型规模进行实验，PathRouter持续提升了答案F1和证据路径重叠度。与强基线相比，3B模型平均F1提升3.1，7B模型平均F1提升4.9。
AI.conclusion: PathRouter通过路径感知的训练框架有效解决了Agentic GraphRAG中结果导向强化学习的固有缺陷，证明引入证据路径信息进行差异化训练可以引导模型学习更可靠的证据检索与推理策略。

title: Post-Hoc Merging is Not Enough: Many-Shot Model Merging with Loss-Gap Balancing
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Model merging has become a practical post-training strategy for building a single multi-task large language model (LLM) by combining multiple task-specialized models. However, most existing approaches rely on post-hoc merging, in which task-specific models are merged only once after training. This one-shot aggregation often suffers from task interference, leading to information erasure across individual tasks. In this work, we show that replacing post-hoc merging with an iterative many-shot merging protocol is effective in improving multi-task performance. Building on this insight, we propose METIS, Mitigating Erasure from Task Interference for Stable many-shot merging. METIS is a loss-aware many-shot merging method that addresses information erasure in post-hoc merging through task-wise loss-gap weighting and consensus-based masking. Notably, METIS exhibits significant performance improvement on the worst-performing task, effectively mitigating information erasure. (Project page: https://imkyungjin.github.io/METIS/)

AI.tldr: 提出METIS方法，用迭代多轮合并替代一次性后验合并，通过任务损失差距加权和共识掩码减少多任务模型合并中的信息擦除问题。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法采用一次性后验合并，不同任务间存在任务干扰，导致信息擦除，影响多任务性能。
AI.method: 提出METIS（Mitigating Erasure from Task Interference for Stable many-shot merging），采用迭代多轮合并协议，结合任务级损失差距加权和共识基掩码来减轻任务干扰和信息擦除。
AI.result: METIS在多项任务上表现优异，尤其在最差任务上性能提升显著，有效缓解了信息擦除问题。
AI.conclusion: 用迭代多轮合并替代一次性后验合并是提升多任务LLM性能的有效策略，METIS方法能稳定实现多轮合并并减轻任务干扰造成的信息擦除。

title: ACCORD: Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding for Language Agents
summary: User instructions are often underspecified because humans rely on implicit assumptions about the surrounding environment. For large language model (LLM) agents operating in information-rich digital and physical environments, these assumptions cannot be inferred from the instruction alone; they must be recovered from the current state of tools, data, interfaces, and observations. Effective execution therefore requires agents to identify missing context, ground it in observed evidence, and carry it forward into subsequent actions. We show that current agents often fail to do so. They act from assumed rather than observed specifics, overlook information they could have gathered, and fail to incorporate evidence that has already been returned. Building on this insight, we propose ACCORD (Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding), a simple and effective agent framework for adaptive grounding. Before each action, ACCORD actively probes the environment for missing information and integrates relevant context from the agent's trajectory that would otherwise be overlooked. Requiring no additional training or task-success signals, ACCORD improves task-goal completion on AppWorld by up to +20.6 points with GPT-5-mini, from 42.0% to 62.6%, compared to strong baselines. These gains persist with a substantially stronger base model (+10.8 with Claude-4.5-sonnet), an open-weight model (+10.1 with Qwen3.5-27B-FP8), and on the embodied AlfWorld benchmark (+7.4 success rate with GPT-5-mini).

AI.tldr: 现有LLM代理常因指令缺乏细节而失败，因为它们依赖假设而非观察到的证据。本文提出ACCORD框架，在每次行动前主动探测环境缺失信息并整合轨迹中的相关上下文，无需额外训练即可显著提升任务完成率（AppWorld最高+20.6%，AlfWorld+7.4%）。
AI.motivation: 用户指令往往因人类依赖环境隐含假设而表述不足，LLM代理在信息丰富的数字和物理环境中无法仅从指令推断这些假设，必须从工具、数据、界面和观察的当前状态中恢复，而现有代理未能做到这一点。
AI.method: 提出ACCORD（Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding）框架，在每次动作前主动探测环境以获取缺失信息，并整合代理轨迹中本可能被忽略的相关上下文，无需额外训练或任务成功信号。
AI.result: 在AppWorld上，GPT-5-mini从42.0%提升至62.6%（+20.6点）；Claude-4.5-sonnet提升+10.8点；Qwen3.5-27B-FP8提升+10.1点；在AlfWorld基准上，GPT-5-mini成功率提升+7.4。
AI.conclusion: ACCORD框架通过主动环境探测和轨迹上下文整合，有效解决了LLM代理因指令模糊而依赖假设导致失败的问题，在不同模型和基准上均表现出一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Model Graph Inductive Learning for Knowledge Graph Completion
summary:
Link prediction in knowledge graphs fundamentally depends on the quality of learned embeddings for entities and relations. However, most existing methods derive these embeddings by aggregating only the local neighborhood of each entity, neglecting the global structure of the knowledge graph. This limited view prevents models from capturing higher-level structural patterns that are essential for accurate and generalizable link prediction.
  To address these limitations, we introduce Model Graph Inductive Learning (\textbf{MGIL}), a framework that constructs a model graph by clustering entities based on the similarity of their incoming and outgoing relational structures or their entity types. A GNN is then applied to this model graph to produce embeddings that capture the global view of the knowledge graph. These embeddings subsequently serve as high-quality initial features %embeddings for the original knowledge graph, replacing random initialization and leading to more stable and expressive representations.
  Extensive experiments on standard and recently proposed inductive benchmarks demonstrate that MGIL achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance in inductive link prediction, highlighting its effectiveness across diverse graph settings.

AI.tldr: 提出MGIL框架，通过构建模型图捕捉知识图谱全局结构，用于归纳链接预测，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱链接预测方法仅聚合局部邻域信息，忽略了全局结构模式，限制了模型的泛化能力和准确性。
AI.method: 基于实体关系结构相似性或实体类型对实体进行聚类，构建模型图；在模型图上应用GNN生成全局嵌入，作为原始知识图谱的高质量初始化特征。
AI.result: 在标准归纳链接预测基准上取得SOTA或极具竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: MGIL通过捕捉全局结构信息，有效提升了归纳链接预测的准确性和泛化能力。

title: DYNA-PRUNER: Input-Adaptive Data-Model Co-Pruning for Efficient and Scalable Spatio-Temporal Media Prediction
summary: Spatio-temporal prediction supports radar/satellite nowcasting and city-scale traffic monitoring, but modern models are often too expensive for real-time deployment. This stems from a mismatch between dense computation and strong input-dependent redundancy (e.g., calm seas or clear skies). To enable automated, resource-aware architecture optimization in scalable media analysis, we propose Dyna-Pruner, an end-to-end framework for input-dependent co-pruning of data and model structure. A shared-importance synchronization mechanism generates coupled masks that prune redundant regions and their corresponding computational units (e.g., convolutional filters), yielding per-sample sparse sub-networks at inference time. Experiments on WeatherBench, SEVIR, and TaxiBJ show seamless integration with CNN, RNN, and Transformer backbones, reducing FLOPs by up to $70\%$ and achieving a $2.5\times$ speedup on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin with negligible accuracy loss ($<1\%$).

AI.tldr: 提出Dyna-Pruner，一种输入依赖的动态剪枝框架，可同时剪枝数据冗余区域和对应计算单元，在保持精度的前提下大幅降低计算量和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测模型存在密集计算与输入强冗余（如平静海面、晴空）的不匹配问题，导致实时部署成本过高。
AI.method: 提出Dyna-Pruner，通过共享重要性同步机制生成耦合掩码，同时剪枝冗余区域及其对应的计算单元（如卷积核），实现每个样本独有的稀疏子网络。
AI.result: 在WeatherBench、SEVIR、TaxiBJ数据集上集成CNN/RNN/Transformer骨干，减少70% FLOPs，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上实现2.5倍加速，精度损失<1%。
AI.conclusion: Dyna-Pruner能有效实现资源自适应的高效时空预测，兼顾精度与实时性。

title: From Awareness to Adherence: Bridging the Context Gap in Spoken Dialogue Systems via Context-Aware Decoding
summary: Despite the success of end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems, maintaining strict context adherence in multi-round conversations remains a challenge. While prior works attribute these failures to models forgetting dialogue history, we highlight an equally critical but overlooked bottleneck: a gap between latent context awareness and active adherence. Although models internally recognize relevant past utterances, strong parametric priors often overshadow these signals during decoding. To bridge this gap, we propose an audio-adapted Context-Aware Decoding (CAD) approach. By leveraging internal attention mechanisms to isolate key historical rounds, our approach contrasts output distributions with and without this key context during inference, directly amplifying multimodal contextual signals. Evaluations on the Audio MultiChallenge benchmark demonstrate significant improvements in Semantic Memory and Self Coherence subtasks, successfully enforcing strict, context-faithful adherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出音频适配的上下文感知解码（CAD）方法，通过对比有无关键历史上下文的输出分布来增强多模态上下文信号，有效解决端到端口语对话系统中上下文忠实遵循的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端口语对话系统在多轮对话中存在上下文遵循困难，以往研究归因于模型遗忘历史对话，但本文指出另一个关键瓶颈：模型内在的潜在上下文感知与主动遵循之间存在差距，即强参数先验在解码时会压制上下文信号。
AI.method: 提出音频适配的上下文感知解码（CAD）方法，利用内部注意力机制隔离关键历史轮次，通过对比有无此关键上下文的输出分布，在推理阶段直接放大多模态上下文信号。
AI.result: 在Audio MultiChallenge基准测试中，该方法在语义记忆和自一致性子任务上取得显著改进，有效实现了严格的上下文忠实遵循。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示并解决了模型潜在上下文感知与主动遵循之间的差距问题，提出的CAD方法通过对比解码策略有效增强了多模态上下文信号的利用，提升了对话系统的上下文忠实度。

title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
summary: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: Kairos是一个面向物理AI的世界模型栈，通过原生预训练范式、统一架构和部署感知系统协同设计，实现了在长时域、跨本体场景下的高效世界知识获取、状态保持与低延迟部署，在多项基准测试中达到顶尖性能。
AI.motivation: 传统世界模型仅作为被动视觉生成器，无法满足物理AI对主动世界知识获取、长时域状态保持和实时部署约束的需求。Kairos旨在构建一个原生、可操作的世界模型基础设施。
AI.method: (1) 原生预训练范式：采用跨本体数据课程，按开放视频→人类行为数据→机器人交互的渐进路径组织数据；(2) 原生统一架构：混合线性时序注意力机制（滑动窗口捕捉局部动态、膨胀滑动窗口捕捉中程依赖、门控线性注意力维持全局持久记忆），并建立了理论误差界；(3) 部署感知系统协同设计：支持服务器和消费级硬件上的低延迟 rollout 生成。
AI.result: 在具身世界模型、长时域和动作策略基准测试中取得顶尖性能，同时在效率与能力之间实现了强平衡。
AI.conclusion: Kairos为未来自我演化的物理智能提供了一个内聚的、可操作的基础设施支撑。

title: Facial Affect Analysis for Service-Oriented Systems: Advances, Challenges, and Future Visions
summary: Facial Affect Analysis (FAA) is evolving from a stand-alone recognition task into a reusable perception capability for Service-Oriented Software Ecosystems (SoSE). This paper preserves the FAA methodological core while reframing recent advances through systems-engineering requirements for composable and dependable services. We review representative progress in static and dynamic expression analysis, action-unit and micro-expression modeling, and modern CNN, Transformer, graph, and hybrid architectures, then interpret these advances by their operational fit in edge, cloud, and hybrid service pipelines. The synthesis emphasizes SoSE concerns that determine deployability: service contracts for uncertainty-aware outputs, latency and availability envelopes, lifecycle monitoring and recalibration, governance-aware integration, and interoperability across independently evolving components. Our analysis shows that benchmark gains alone are insufficient for SoSE readiness; robustness under shift, intervention stability, fairness, privacy posture, and runtime guarantees are equally critical. We conclude with a roadmap for treating FAA as an operational service component with explicit interfaces, measurable quality attributes, and accountable lifecycle management.

AI.tldr: 本文从面向服务软件生态系统（SoSE）的视角，重新审视面部情感分析（FAA）领域的最新进展，强调其从独立识别任务向可复用感知能力的转变，并提出了基于系统工程的部署就绪评估框架。
AI.motivation: 传统FAA研究多聚焦于基准性能提升，忽视了作为服务组件在边缘、云等混合流水线中部署时所需满足的系统工程要求。本文旨在将FAA重新定位为SoSE中的可组合、可信赖服务，填补算法研究与服务部署之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 保留FAA方法学核心，通过系统工程视角系统回顾静态/动态表情分析、动作单元和微表情建模，以及CNN、Transformer、图网络和混合架构的最新进展，并从操作适配性角度（边缘、云、混合服务流水线）进行解读。
AI.result: 仅依靠基准性能提升不足以支撑SoSE就绪；鲁棒性（分布偏移下）、干预稳定性、公平性、隐私保护以及运行时保障同样关键。
AI.conclusion: 提出了将FAA视为具备显式接口、可度量质量属性和可问责生命周期管理的可操作服务组件的路线图。

title: Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Under review at EMNLP 2026
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) lets vision-language systems answer questions that exceed their parametric knowledge by conditioning a reader on passages retrieved from a Wikipedia-scale knowledge base. In pure-text long-context LLMs, retrieved-context use follows the U-shaped "lost-in-the-middle" effect of Liu et al. (2024): information at the start and end of context is used, the middle is lost. Whether this transfers to deployed multimodal KB-VQA is open. To close this gap, we design the first controlled probe of reader-side position dependence in multimodal KB-VQA: a gold-position protocol in which only the gold passage's prompt slot varies within question. We run it on three open-source 7B/8B VLM readers and two KB-VQA benchmarks at k up to 20. The shape flips from U to primacy: gold-at-first beats gold-at-last by 16 to 26 points on every reader-by-benchmark cell, an effect we call "Lost at the End". Three targeted ablations narrow the cause: a text-only control shows the multimodal setting amplifies an already-present text-mode primacy 2.2 to 4.5 times, and image-position and distractor-shuffle ablations together pin the locus to prompt slot 0 of the instruction-tuned reader. On a frozen reader, three retrieval-side fixes (MMR, oracle reranking, rank-based reordering) all leave the gap intact (no separable improvement). Our findings indicate that recall@k is the wrong metric for deployed KB-VQA and that closing the gap requires reader-side intervention; we release our protocol as a controlled instrument for evaluating such interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统性地揭示了多模态知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）系统中一个反直觉的"结尾丢失"现象：与纯文本的U型注意力分布（丢失中间）不同，多模态大模型在检索增强时呈现出强烈的首因效应，即首位黄金段落准确率比末位高出16-26个百分点。通过消融实验，发现该现象由指令微调模型的第0提示槽位主导，文本模态的首因效应在多模态环境下被放大了2.2-4.5倍，且检索侧优化（MMR、重排序等）均无法弥补这一差距，必须进行读者端干预。
AI.motivation: 纯文本长上下文LLM中存在"丢失在中间"的U型位置依赖效应，但该效应是否迁移到多模态KB-VQA系统中尚不清楚。作者旨在填补这一空白，首次设计可控实验来探测多模态KB-VQA中读者端的位置依赖性。
AI.method: 设计"黄金位置协议"(gold-position protocol)，控制检索段落中仅黄金段落的提示槽位位置变化，在3个开源7B/8B VLM读者和2个KB-VQA基准上（k≤20）进行系统评估，并通过文本对照、图像位置消融、干扰项打乱消融等三项消融实验定位原因。
AI.result: 多模态KB-VQA中位置效应从U型翻转为首因效应：首位黄金段落准确率比末位高16-26个百分点（"丢失在结尾"）。检索侧修复（MMR、Oracle重排序、基于排名的重排序）均无法缩小差距。多模态环境将文本首因效应放大2.2-4.5倍，原因定位于指令微调读者的第0提示槽位。
AI.conclusion: Recall@k是部署KB-VQA的错误指标，缩小差距需要读者端干预。作者将协议作为评估干预措施的受控工具开源。

title: The Faithfulness Gap: Certifying Semantic Equivalence Between Natural-Language and Formal Mathematical Statements
summary: Autoformalization, translating natural-language mathematics into formal proof assistants, is bottlenecked not by translation fluency but by \emph{faithfulness}: a formal statement can typecheck and be provable, yet still encode a different theorem than the source intended. We introduce \emph{Bidirectional Provability Fingerprinting} (\bpf{}), a framework that certifies faithfulness by characterizing each candidate through its forward and backward consequence neighborhoods in the ambient theory and matching these against probes derived from the natural-language statement. We further introduce four novel components: (i) \emph{Counterfactual Probe Generation} (\cpg{}), a contrastive procedure that synthesizes probes targeting specific drift directions; (ii) the \emph{Equivalence Spectrum}, a continuous faithfulness score that replaces brittle binary verdicts; (iii) \emph{Adaptive Probe Budget Allocation} (\apba{}), an information-theoretic budget router; and (iv) \emph{Faithfulness-Guided Decoding} (\fgd{}), which uses \bpf{} signals as a reward during autoformalization. We prove a \emph{drift detection theorem} and a \emph{PAC-faithfulness} result establishing that the equivalence class of a natural language statement is learnable from $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/δ)/\varepsilon)$ probes under mild assumptions. We release \driftbench{}, a benchmark of $2{,}183$ NL/Lean~4 pairs with controlled drift labels across six subfields of mathlib4. \bpf{}\,+\,\cpg{} detects $89.6\%$ of drifted formalizations at a $3.0\%$ false-positive rate-against $41.2\%$ for typecheck and $63.3\%$ for LLM-judge baselines, and \fgd{} reduces the rate at which a state-of-the-art autoformalizer emits drifted statements by $47\%$. https://pmlrbd.github.io/BPF/

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向可证性指纹（BPF）框架，通过前向和后向推论的邻域匹配来认证自动形式化过程的忠实性，并引入四个新组件，在检测形式化漂移方面显著优于类型检查和LLM评判基线。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化的瓶颈在于忠实性而非流畅性：形式化语句可能类型检查通过且可证明，但编码的定理与原始自然语言意图不同。现有方法缺乏对这种语义漂移的可靠检测机制。
AI.method: 提出BPF框架，通过候选形式化语句在环境理论中的前向和后向推论邻域与自然语言导出的探针进行匹配来认证忠实性；并引入四个新组件：反事实探针生成（CPG）、等价谱（连续忠实性评分）、自适应探针预算分配（APBA）和忠实性引导解码（FGD）。
AI.result: BPF+CPG检测出89.6%的漂移形式化，假阳性率仅3.0%；类型检查基线41.2%，LLM评判基线63.3%。FGD将最先进自动形式化器的漂移语句率降低47%。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论上证明了漂移检测定理和PAC忠实性结果，表明在温和假设下，自然语言语句的等价类可以从O(log(1/δ)/ε)个探针中学习；并发布了包含2,183个NL/Lean4对的DriftBench基准数据集。

title: Sustainable Face Recognition on Low-Power Devices with VQ-VAE Embeddings
summary: Face recognition has become a cornerstone of modern AI applications, yet conventional approaches often rely on computationally intensive models deployed in cloud environments, leading to increased network traffic, high energy consumption, and a heavy carbon footprint. This work introduces a sustainable, edge-deployable face recognition framework based on Vector-Quantized Variational Autoencoders (VQ-VAE), which generates compact and semantically rich latent representations of facial images. By leveraging the compression capacity and reconstruction quality of VQ-VAE embeddings on the edge and combining them with the power of pre-trained face embeddings in a knowledge distillation setup, our system achieves comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art face embedding models while significantly reducing memory and computation requirements on the edge, making it suitable for low-power edge devices. The integration of VQ-VAE compression minimizes network overhead while keeping the matching accuracy high by retaining only the most informative facial features in the latent space. As a result, the reconstructed images preserve the key identity characteristics, improving the robustness and overall performance of the face embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于VQ-VAE的可持续、可边缘部署的人脸识别框架，通过压缩潜在表示和知识蒸馏，在边缘设备上实现与云级模型相当的准确率，同时大幅降低计算、存储和能耗。
AI.motivation: 传统人脸识别依赖云端高计算量模型，导致网络流量大、能耗高、碳足迹重，亟需一种可持续的边缘部署方案。
AI.method: 利用VQ-VAE生成紧凑的潜在表示，结合预训练人脸嵌入进行知识蒸馏，在边缘端实现高效压缩与高精度匹配。
AI.result: 在显著降低内存和计算需求的同时，保持了与最先进人脸嵌入模型相当的准确率，并减少了网络开销。
AI.conclusion: VQ-VAE压缩能有效保留关键身份特征，提升嵌入鲁棒性，适合低功耗边缘设备，为可持续AI提供了可行路径。

title: REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience
summary: Large multimodal language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for guiding evolutionary search toward interpretable programmatic policies. However, existing frameworks rely on a monolithic model call to simultaneously interpret visual behavioral evidence and synthesize corrective code. This diagnosis-repair entanglement creates an opaque feedback loop, obscuring the rationale behind mutations and preventing the retention of algorithmic insights across independent runs. To achieve auditable and efficient policy search, we argue that visual diagnosis must be structurally decoupled from code generation. We present REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework that operationalizes this decoupling. In REFLEX, a vision-enabled Critic first distills task-specific behavioral evidence into structured, auditable diagnoses. Subsequently, a text-optimized Actor synthesizes child policies using these diagnoses alongside a persistent, self-evolving Skill Memory of reusable code snippets. This architecture not only provides transparent mutation traces but also enables cross-run programmatic knowledge transfer. Extensive evaluations across control benchmarks (Lunar Lander, Acrobot, Pendulum) and a 36-dimensional antenna array synthesis task demonstrate exceptional sample efficiency. Notably, REFLEX solves Acrobot and Pendulum in under 10 LLM calls and reaches a best Normalized Weighted Score of 1.092 on Lunar Lander, achieving highly competitive final performance while significantly accelerating the early-stage discovery of transparent policies.

AI.tldr: REFLEX是一种无训练框架，将视觉诊断与代码生成解耦，通过可审计的诊断和技能记忆实现高效的策略搜索，在多个控制基准上展现出卓越的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将视觉诊断与代码生成耦合在一起，导致反馈不透明、无法跨运行复用算法知识，阻碍了策略搜索的可审计性和效率。
AI.method: REFLEX采用视觉诊断的Critic模块生成结构化可审计的诊断结果，再由文本优化的Actor结合诊断和自进化的技能记忆合成策略代码，实现了诊断与生成的解耦。
AI.result: 在Lunar Lander、Acrobot、Pendulum和天线阵列合成任务上，REFLEX表现出优异的样本效率，Acrobot和Pendulum在10次LLM调用内解决，Lunar Lander最佳归一化加权分数达1.092。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉诊断与代码生成解耦能够实现可审计、高效且跨运行可迁移的策略搜索，显著加速透明策略的早期发现。

title: ROSA-RL: Uncertainty-Aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Copyright 2026 IEEE. This is the accepted manuscript for 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), not the final published version
summary: Roundabouts challenge automated driving in mixed traffic, as heterogeneous and non-deterministic human behavior, unknown driving intentions, and high interaction complexity create uncertainty about whether the conflict zone will be blocked or available at the moment of entry. We present ROSA-RL -- uncertainty-aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning. It enables safe and efficient roundabout entry for automated and human-driven vehicles in mixed traffic through probabilistic conflict forecasting. A Transformer-based model predicts conflict zone occupancy over a five-second horizon, capturing multi-agent interactions to anticipate upcoming conflicts and available gaps. The prediction outputs encode uncertainty in future motion and intent, and augment the state of a classical RL framework, enabling uncertainty-aware speed coordination. Evaluated in simulations grounded in real-world data, ROSA-RL can effectively handle uncertainty and outperform a comparable model-based baseline, closing the gap to an ideal setting assuming fully known occupancy while improving traffic efficiency and safety. The source code of this work is available under: github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA-RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROSA-RL，一种基于强化学习和Transformer概率冲突预测的方法，用于在混合交通中实现环形交叉口的安全高效通行，通过预测未来5秒内冲突区域占用情况来处理不确定性，在模拟实验中优于基线模型，接近理想全知状态。
AI.motivation: 环形交叉口在混合交通中对自动驾驶构成挑战，因为人类行为异质且非确定、驾驶意图未知、交互复杂度高，导致车辆进入时冲突区域是否被占用存在不确定性。现有方法难以有效处理这种不确定性。
AI.method: 采用Transformer模型预测未来5秒的冲突区域占用情况，捕捉多智能体交互以预测潜在冲突和可用间隙；预测结果编码未来运动和意图的不确定性，并增强经典强化学习框架的状态空间，实现不确定性感知的速度协调。
AI.result: 在基于真实世界数据的模拟评估中，ROSA-RL能够有效处理不确定性，性能优于基于模型的基线方法，缩小了与假设完全已知占用情况的理想设置之间的差距，同时提升了交通效率和安全性。
AI.conclusion: ROSA-RL通过概率冲突预测与强化学习相结合，为混合交通中环形交叉口的自动驾驶提供了一种不确定性感知的解决方案，在安全性和效率上均表现出色，代码已开源。

title: SkillWiki: A Living Knowledge Infrastructure for Agent Skills
summary: While knowledge is managed through Wikipedia and software through GitHub, agent skills still lack an infrastructure for large-scale production, governance, and evolution. SkillWiki is a living knowledge infrastructure that supports the organization, grounding, and continuous evolution of agent skills by transforming heterogeneous knowledge into reusable skill assets linked to their originating evidence. Our demonstration presents the complete skill lifecycle, from knowledge ingestion and skill production to provenance-aware exploration, governance, and execution-driven evolution. SkillWiki highlights a future in which knowledge, skills, and execution experience co-evolve within a shared infrastructure. The live demonstration and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/Huangdingcheng/SkillWiki.

AI.tldr: SkillWiki是一个支持智能体技能全生命周期管理（从知识摄入、技能生产到溯源探索、治理和执行驱动进化）的开放基础设施，实现了知识、技能与执行经验的协同演化。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体技能缺乏类似Wikipedia（知识管理）和GitHub（软件管理）那样的大规模生产、治理和演进的基础设施。
AI.method: 构建SkillWiki基础设施，将异构知识转化为可复用的技能资产，并与原始证据链接，支持技能的完整生命周期管理。
AI.result: 实现了从知识摄入、技能生产、溯源探索、治理到执行驱动进化的完整技能生命周期演示。
AI.conclusion: SkillWiki展示了知识、技能和执行经验在共享基础设施中协同演化的未来愿景。

title: TNODEV: Toolbox for Neural ODE Verification
comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, Under review in TMLR
summary: Neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODE) have started to appear in safety critical settings such as continuous-time controllers for cyber-physical systems and classifiers integrated into automated decision pipelines, raising the question of whether their behavior can be formally verified. Existing tools dedicated to neural ODE provide only a single reachability call without iterative input set refinement, limiting the precision of their verdicts to whatever one reachability call can deliver. We present TNODEV, the first sound formal verifier for neural ODE that integrates a falsification checker, a fast interval-based reachability backend based on continuous-time mixed monotonicity, a verification and refinement loop with three input-set splitting heuristics, and a parallel scheduler in a single end-to-end pipeline. TNODEV supports safe-set inclusion verification on pure neural ODE, neural ODE in closed loop with a neural network controller and general neural ODE (GNODE), with the safe set specified either as an interval or as the half-space intersection induced by a target classification label. We evaluate TNODEV on a range of benchmarks across safe-set inclusion and classification-robustness properties, including a direct reachability comparison against NNV~2.0 and CORA and a verification comparison against NNV2.0 on MNIST general neural ODE classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TNODEV，首个支持迭代输入集细化的神经ODE形式验证器，集成了反例搜索、基于混合单调性的区间可达性分析、三种分割启发式策略和并行调度，在安全集包含验证和分类鲁棒性验证上优于现有工具。
AI.motivation: 神经ODE已应用于安全关键场景（如连续时间控制器和分类器），但其行为能否被形式化验证仍是一个问题。现有工具仅支持单次可达性调用，缺乏输入集迭代细化，精度受限。
AI.method: 提出TNODEV，集成四个核心组件：1）反例检查器（falsification checker）；2）基于连续时间混合单调性的快速区间可达性后端；3）三种输入集分割启发式策略的验证与细化循环；4）并行调度器。支持纯神经ODE、闭环神经ODE（含神经网络控制器）和通用神经ODE（GNODE）的安全集验证。
AI.result: 在安全集包含和分类鲁棒性基准测试上进行了评估，包括与NNV 2.0和CORA的可达性对比，以及在MNIST通用神经ODE分类器上与NNV 2.0的验证对比，表明TNODEV性能更优。
AI.conclusion: TNODEV是首个实现迭代输入集细化的神经ODE形式验证器，在精度和效率上超越了现有单次可达性工具，为神经ODE在安全关键系统中的部署提供了更可靠的验证手段。

title: Timestep Rescheduling in Diffusion Inversion
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026. 23 pages, including appendices
summary: Diffusion inversion, which maps images back to the Gaussian latent space of a diffusion model, is a critical task for image reconstruction and editing. While DDIM enables fast deterministic inversion, it inherently introduces deviations that accumulate into noticeable inversion errors. Existing methods often address this by solving a fixed-point problem but largely overlook how the selection of the diffusion timestep in the noise scheduler influences inversion fidelity. In this work, we reveal that the deviation scale in diffusion inversion is strongly dependent on the timestep size, and exhibits a parabolic trend, with larger errors concentrated at both small and large timesteps. Based on this finding, we propose a simple yet effective nonuniform timestep scheduler that integrates a global rescaling with a local dynamic programming based rescheduling, enabling a strategic allocation of computational effort that minimizes the overall inversion error and preserves higher inversion accuracy. Our method serves as an off-the-shelf enhancement for existing inversion techniques and requires no extra parameters or computational overhead. Through extensive experiments, we verify that integrating our scheduler consistently boosts the performance of existing inversion methods, achieving superior results in image reconstruction and editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非均匀时间步调度器，通过全局重缩放和局部动态规划重新调度，有效减少扩散模型反演误差，可即插即用地提升现有反演方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散反演方法常通过求解不动点问题来减少误差，但忽略了噪声调度器中扩散时间步长对反演保真度的影响。本文发现反演偏差与时间步大小呈抛物线趋势，误差集中在极小和极大时间步上。
AI.method: 提出非均匀时间步调度器，包含全局重缩放和基于局部动态规划的重新调度，通过策略性分配计算资源来最小化整体反演误差。
AI.result: 该方法可作为现成增强模块，无需额外参数或计算开销；实验证明集成该调度器能一致地提升现有反演方法的性能，在图像重建和编辑任务中取得更优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过揭示反演误差与时间步大小的抛物线关系，提出非均匀调度策略，显著提升扩散模型反演的精度和实用性。

title: Can LLM Coding Agents Reason About Time Series?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for automated decision-making systems in finance, healthcare, or environmental monitoring. Time series data are ubiquitous in these fields, yet hard to process automatically. Can time series be analyzed by LLM agents? We examine three approaches: providing the agent with raw numerical data, using the LLM as a coding agent, or a combination of both. In the coding agent setup, the model iteratively queries the data using Python code. Using two time series understanding benchmarks, we show that agents with code access can outperform models processing raw data by up to 10%. However, even the best performing agent still answers about 22-34% of the questions incorrectly. To get insights into models' strategies and reasoning gaps, we analyze the model outputs with a strong LLM judge. Our analysis reveals that coding agents can select appropriate statistical tests, but often miss important nuances. Meanwhile, models with access to raw data can reach the right conclusions using back-of-the-envelope calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了LLM代理如何分析时间序列数据，比较了原始数据输入、代码代理以及两者结合三种方式。实验表明，代码代理性能最佳（准确率提升10%），但仍有22-34%的问题回答错误。通过LLM裁判分析发现，代码代理能选择正确统计方法但忽略细微差别，而原始数据模型则能通过快速估算得出正确结论。
AI.motivation: 时间序列数据在金融、医疗和环境监测等领域广泛存在且难以自动处理，而LLM正被越来越多地用于自动化决策系统。本文旨在探究LLM代理能否有效分析时间序列数据，并比较不同方法的优劣。
AI.method: 设计了三种实验设置：1) 向代理提供原始数值数据；2) 将LLM作为代码代理，通过Python代码迭代查询数据；3) 两者结合。使用两个时间序列理解基准进行评测，并用强LLM裁判分析模型输出策略与推理缺陷。
AI.result: 代码代理相比处理原始数据的模型性能提升约10%，但最佳代理仍有22-34%的问题回答错误。代码代理能选择恰当的统计检验但常忽略重要细节，而原始数据模型可通过快速估算得出正确结论。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理能够分析时间序列数据，代码访问显著提升性能，但当前方法仍存在显著推理缺陷，尤其是细微之处的把握不足，需要进一步改进。

title: ARB4WM: An Adversarial Robustness Benchmark for World Models in Continuous Control
comment: 24 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Source code available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM
summary: World models are widely used in robotic and agentic engineering control systems due to their ability to learn latent dynamics for planning and decision-making. As these systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, understanding their robustness under adversarial conditions has become essential. However, existing evaluations lack a unified benchmark for testing adversarial threats across the policy, value, and latent-dynamics levels of world-model agents. To fill this gap, we present ARB4WM, a unified evaluation framework for pre-deployment robustness and risk assessment of world-model agents under visual perturbations. ARB4WM defines five white-box loss objectives across these three levels and studies their effects when combined with single-step or multi-step perturbation strategies and temporal attack modes, including full-frame, half-sequence, and sparse-frame exposure. Specifically, we evaluate four Dreamer-style agents across 20 tasks from MetaWorld and the DeepMind Control Suite under different loss objectives, perturbation strategies, and temporal attack modes. Results show that attacks targeting value estimation, latent representations, and RSSM dynamics can be as damaging as direct policy disruption, and that early or frequent perturbations are especially harmful, while input-level defenses provide limited recovery under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that safety, risk, and reliability assessment for world models should cover multiple component-oriented attack objectives and temporal exposure protocols rather than relying solely on action-space robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM.

AI.tldr: 提出ARB4WM，一个用于评估世界模型代理在视觉扰动下鲁棒性的统一基准框架，覆盖策略、价值和潜在动力学三个层次的攻击目标。
AI.motivation: 现有评估缺乏统一的基准来测试世界模型代理在策略、价值和潜在动力学层面的对抗威胁。
AI.method: 定义五个白盒损失目标（覆盖三个层次），结合单步/多步扰动策略和时间攻击模式（全帧、半序列、稀疏帧），在MetaWorld和DeepMind Control Suite的20个任务上评估Dreamer-style代理。
AI.result: 攻击价值估计、潜在表示和RSSM动态与直接策略破坏同样有害；早期或频繁扰动危害尤其大；输入级防御在自适应攻击下恢复能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的安全性评估应覆盖多组件攻击目标和时间暴露协议，而非仅依赖动作空间鲁棒性。

title: Segmentation-based Detection for Efficient Multi-Task Spacecraft Perception
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. CVPRW AI4SPACE-SPARK 2026 Challenge Stream-1 First Place Winners. Code is available at https://github.com/sivaastro/segdet-spark
summary: Vision-based perception is fundamental to Space Situational Awareness and autonomous on-orbit operations such as rendezvous, docking, servicing, and navigation. However, progress in this area is limited by the scarcity of annotated space imagery and by challenging visual-domain characteristics including severe illumination changes, low signal-to-noise ratio, and high contrast.
