comment: Accepted in IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026 MetaFood Workshop
summary: Realistic visual simulation of food manipulation requires accurate material parameters, yet these are difficult to measure directly and vary across the heterogeneous regions of a single food item. We address the inverse problem of estimating material parameters from a target description of fracture behavior in a non-differentiable continuum damage mechanics simulator. Using orange peeling as a test case, we train a neural surrogate on 2,000 forward simulations and compare Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES, a gradient-free evolutionary optimizer) with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm) across the original 9-dimensional parameter space and two learned 4-dimensional latent representations. Since different oranges have different material properties, a practical inverse system must handle arbitrary targets without retraining. We train a goal-conditioned PPO policy that learns a general inverse mapping: given any target description of peeling behavior, the policy produces a material parameter estimate in a single forward pass (8 surrogate evaluations, approximately 10ms). Operating in a normalizing flow latent space with a shared surrogate evaluator, the goal-conditioned policy achieves 0.642 actual recovery when validated through the simulator, outperforming the original parameter space by 23%. A warm-start extension that initializes CMA-ES refinement from the policy's output further improves recovery to 0.828 with 540 evaluations. These findings provide a practical framework for inverse food physics and lay groundwork for vision-driven material identification from video observations of food manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用橙子剥皮作为测试案例，提出了一种结合神经代理模型和强化学习的逆向物理参数估计方法，通过目标条件PPO策略在归一化流潜空间中实现了0.642的材料参数恢复率，结合CMA-ES微调后可提升至0.828。
AI.motivation: 食物操作的真实视觉模拟需要准确的材质参数，但直接测量困难且食物内部存在异质性，因此需要从断裂行为的目标准则中逆向估计材料参数。
AI.method: 使用2000次正向仿真训练神经代理模型，比较CMA-ES与PPO两种优化方法；引入目标条件PPO策略学习通用的逆向映射，并在归一化流潜空间结合共享代理评估器进行参数估计，最后提出基于策略输出的CMA-ES热启动扩展。
AI.result: 目标条件PPO在归一化流潜空间实现0.642的实际恢复率，比原始参数空间提升23%；结合CMA-ES热启动微调后恢复率提升至0.828。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为逆向食品物理学提供了实用框架，并为基于视频观察的食物操作视觉驱动材料识别奠定了基础。

title: Simulation-Based Multi-Fillet Evaluation of Woody Breast Poultry Fillets
comment: To be published in the 2026 International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE)
summary: Woody breast (WB) is a myopathy in modern broiler chickens that causes the breast muscle to become unusually stiff and fibrous, leading to decreased meat quality and significant economic losses. State-of-the-art automated WB detection relies on a side-view imaging system to analyze the bending behavior of a single fillet as it falls off a conveyor belt. While highly accurate, this approach is constrained by its single-fillet field of view, creating throughput bottlenecks on commercial processing lines. In this paper, we address this limitation via a novel multi-fillet detection architecture utilizing a top-down camera configuration. To validate our approach, we first develop a high-fidelity digital twin of an industrial conveyor system. Next, we synthesize a diverse dataset of 3D fillet meshes and model their viscoelastic bending dynamics using a physics-based simulation engine. Lastly, a continuous 2D shape deformation score is extracted from the top-down perspective as the simulated fillets traverse the roller precipice. Experimental results demonstrate that the top-down shape score effectively captures the contour changes of the fillets as it bends, providing a robust and scalable alternative to a side-view imaging system for simultaneous multi-fillet WB evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于俯视成像的多鸡胸肉木质化（WB）检测架构，通过数字孪生和物理仿真生成数据集，并提取二维形状变形分数，实现了对多个鸡胸肉同步、高效、可扩展的WB检测，解决了传统侧视单通道检测的吞吐量瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统侧视WB检测系统每次只能分析单个鸡胸肉，在生产线上形成吞吐量瓶颈，无法满足商业加工线的高效需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建工业传送带系统的高保真数字孪生；2) 合成多样化的3D鸡胸肉网格数据集，利用物理引擎模拟粘弹性弯曲动力学；3) 从俯视视角提取连续的二维形状变形分数，量化鸡胸肉弯曲过程中的轮廓变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，俯视形状变形分数能有效捕捉鸡胸肉弯曲时的轮廓变化，为多鸡胸肉同步WB评估提供了鲁棒且可扩展的方案。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的俯视多鸡胸肉检测架构是侧视单通道系统的一种有效替代方案，能够支持同时评估多个鸡胸肉，提升了检测吞吐量。

title: A Multi-Center Benchmark for Abdominal Disease Diagnosis and Report Generation from Non-Contrast CT
summary: Multiphasic contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) is widely used for abdominal lesion characterization, yet it carries inherent risks of contrast-induced nephropathy, escalates acquisition burden, and heavily contributes to radiologist workload. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel multi-center benchmark for multi-organ abdominal disease diagnosis and automated radiology report generation, which learns to synthesize contrast-enhanced findings from single-phase non-contrast CT (NCCT). To support this, we curated a large-scale dataset of paired NCCT-CECT studies and their corresponding contrast-enhanced radiology reports from two centers, partitioned into internal sets and an external validation cohort. Under a unified evaluation protocol, we benchmarked five contemporary deep learning architectures encompassing chest-specific, abdomen-specific, and general-purpose multimodal domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NCCT retains diagnostic signals, achieving an average multi-organ AUC of 69.1% on the internal cohort and 63.1% on the external cohort, respectively. By releasing this dataset and standardized benchmark publicly, this study aims to catalyze future research into safer, resource-efficient, and globally accessible contrast-free abdominal imaging workflows. Code is available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/TriALS-Report.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多中心基准，用于从单期非增强CT（NCCT）合成对比增强结果，实现腹部多器官疾病诊断和自动化报告生成，以减少对比剂相关风险和放射科医生负担。
AI.motivation: 多期增强CT存在对比剂肾病风险、采集负担重、放射科医生工作量大等问题，亟需探索更安全的无对比剂腹部成像方案。
AI.method: 构建了来自两个中心的大规模配对NCCT-CECT数据集及对应增强报告，在统一评估协议下，测试了五种当代深度学习架构（含胸部专用、腹部专用和通用多模态模型）。
AI.result: NCCT保留了诊断信号，内部队列平均多器官AUC达69.1%，外部验证队列达63.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过公开数据集和标准化基准，推动更安全、资源高效、全球可及的无对比剂腹部成像研究。

title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
summary: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding that retains PRoPE's projective camera geometry while applying camera-aware attention to spatially reduced tokens. We convert a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. Training on self-generated long-horizon contexts exposes the model to its own generated history and reduces the style and color drift that accumulates across autoregressive chunks. Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence retrieves earlier views through camera-geometry-based retrieval, while residual recycling makes the conditioning path less sensitive to imperfect memory latents. Event Instruction Tuning adds composable event control, and reinforcement learning alignment recovers camera control and visual quality after distillation. With mixed-precision DiT execution, residual reuse, 75\%-pruned VAE decoding, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism, DreamX-World 1.0 reaches up to 16\,FPS on eight RTX\,5090 GPUs. On our 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World 1.0 achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and an overall score of 84.76, outperforming HY-WorldPlay 1.5 and LingBot-World in overall score, which achieve 80.79 and 80.45, respectively.

AI.tldr: DreamX-World 1.0 是一个通用的交互式文/图到视频世界模型，支持可控长程生成、相机导航、场景重访和事件控制，通过 E-PRoPE 编码、自回归扩散训练、记忆条件场景保持等技术，在 8 张 RTX 5090 上达到 16 FPS，总体得分 84.76，优于对比模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型缺乏长程可控性、相机精确控制和场景一致性，尤其在跨域（写实、游戏、风格化）场景中难以实现交互式导航和事件触发。
AI.method: 提出 E-PRoPE 编码用于相机控制；采用因果强制、DMD 蒸馏和长展开训练将双向扩散模型转为自回归世界模型；引入记忆条件场景保持和残差回收；事件指令微调实现组合事件控制；通过混合精度 DiT、VAE 剪枝和异步流水线并行加速推理。
AI.result: 在 5 秒基础评测中，相机控制得分为 73.75，总体得分 84.76，优于 HY-WorldPlay 1.5（80.79）和 LingBot-World（80.45），在 8 张 RTX 5090 上实现最高 16 FPS。
AI.conclusion: DreamX-World 1.0 在长程可控视频生成上达到领先性能，验证了自回归扩散世界模型结合精确相机控制与记忆机制的可行性。

title: MeshLoom: Feed-Forward Non-Rigid Registration of Mesh Sequences
summary: We present MeshLoom, a feed-forward registration network that directly reconstructs vertex deformations across mesh sequences. Our approach advances non-rigid registration beyond existing models, which are typically constrained by costly per-instance optimization, narrow object categories, pairwise-only inputs, or merely intermediate outputs. The network is simple and efficient, registering multiple meshes within seconds. At its core lies a topology-aware encoder--decoder design. Specifically, we first introduce a topology-aware point representation that encodes the anchor (reference) mesh's topology into its per-vertex features. This representation strengthens the network's understanding of the anchor-mesh geometry and disambiguates points that are Euclidean-close yet geodesically distant. We then propose a multi-modal encoder that fuses this anchor-mesh representation with complementary cues from each frame, such as shape latents and image features. These multi-source signals are compressed into a compact global motion embedding that captures dense inter-frame correspondence. A lightweight decoder then queries this global embedding with the anchor-mesh point representation, retrieving per-vertex deformations at target timestamps. Through extensive experiments across diverse motions and object categories, we show that MeshLoom achieves state-of-the-art results on non-rigid registration. In addition, we find that our global embedding-then-query paradigm naturally enables the network to generate deformations at intermediate timestamps, which extends MeshLoom to motion interpolation and mesh morphing. Project page: https://meshloom.github.io/ .

AI.tldr: MeshLoom是一种前馈式配准网络，通过拓扑感知的编码器-解码器设计，直接从网格序列中重建顶点形变，在非刚性配准中达到SOTA，并支持运动插值和网格变形。
AI.motivation: 现有非刚性配准方法受限于逐实例优化成本高、对象类别狭窄、仅支持成对输入或仅生成中间输出等问题，缺乏高效、通用的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出拓扑感知的锚点网格点表示，编码网格拓扑到逐顶点特征；设计多模态编码器融合锚点网格表征与每帧的形状潜码、图像特征，压缩为全局运动嵌入；轻量解码器通过查询该嵌入恢复逐顶点形变。
AI.result: 在多种运动类型和物体类别上取得非刚性配准的SOTA结果，并在数秒内完成多个网格的配准。
AI.conclusion: MeshLoom的全局嵌入-查询范式自然支持中间时间戳形变生成，可扩展到运动插值和网格变形任务。

title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: A Survey of Streaming Large Language Models
summary: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly designed for static inference with pre-defined inputs, which limits their applicability in dynamic, real-time scenarios. To address this gap, the streaming LLM paradigm has emerged. However, existing definitions of streaming LLMs remain fragmented, conflating streaming generation, streaming inputs, and interactive streaming architectures, while a systematic taxonomy is still lacking. This paper provides a comprehensive overview and analysis of streaming LLMs. First, we establish a unified definition of streaming LLMs based on data flow and dynamic interaction to clarify existing ambiguities. Building on this definition, we propose a systematic taxonomy of current streaming LLMs and conduct an in-depth discussion on their underlying methodologies. Furthermore, we explore the applications of streaming LLMs in real-world scenarios and outline promising research directions to support ongoing advances in streaming intelligence. We maintain a continuously updated repository of relevant papers at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Awesome-Streaming-LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了流式大语言模型（Streaming LLMs）领域的研究，提出了统一的定义和分类体系，并讨论了其方法、应用与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 现有流式LLM的定义存在碎片化，混淆了流式生成、流式输入和交互式流式架构，缺乏系统的分类体系，需要建立统一框架以澄清概念歧义。
AI.method: 首先基于数据流和动态交互建立流式LLM的统一定义，然后提出系统的分类法对现有流式LLM进行分类，并深入讨论其方法论基础。
AI.result: 提出了统一的流式LLM定义和系统分类体系，分析了各类方法的优缺点，并总结了实际应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为流式LLM研究提供了清晰的理论框架，指出了未来研究方向，有助于推动流式智能的持续发展。
